text:
Kestrel planning for 3–10 November, led by Maya, Jonah, Ken, Sofia, and Lena, sets final configuration values for cache, upload, webhooks, session, auth, catalog, export, gateway, and checkout. Three couplings apply: catalog retry_limit above 6 requires feed ttl_s of at least 540; checkout timeout_s above 65 requires gateway timeout_s of at least 120; and session queue_depth above 40 caps reports batch_size at 150.

Placement assigns ledger to beta; metrics, catalog, returns, export, and checkout to alpha; and feed and webhooks to delta. Pricing and session share a worker, as do alerts and auth.

Constraints: no dependency path from metrics to catalog; auth must not depend on catalog; gateway must not depend on webhooks; ingest must not depend on pricing; and gateway must roll out before auth.

Other notes: the security review and on-call rota change next month, and the budget review moved to next Thursday.
